title: Weighting Filter
text: Weighted frequency response filter, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Mask for attenuation limits} sets Creates a; {Weighting method} sets the type of frequency, {Inherit sample rate from input} sets the source of input sample rate, {Input sample rate (Hz)} sets the sample rate of input, {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run, {Visualize filter response} sets the open plot to visualize magnitude response and compliance mask, {Variable name}, {Overwrite variable if it already exists} and {Export filter to workspace}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Weighting method
params.values: Type of frequency weighting A-weighting (default) | C-weighting | K-weighting

params.name: Inherit sample rate from input
params.values: Specify source of input sample rate off (default) | on

params.name: Input sample rate (Hz)
params.values: Sample rate of input 44100 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Specify type of simulation to run Code generation (default) | Interpreted execution

params.name: Mask for attenuation limits
params.values: Creates a mask for filter response visualization No mask (default) | Class 1 | Class 2

params.name: Visualize filter response
params.values: Open plot to visualize magnitude response and compliance mask button

params.name: Variable name
params.values: Variable name of exported filter myFilt (default) | valid variable name

params.name: Overwrite variable if it already exists
params.values: Overwrite variable if it already exists on (default) | off
